provenance.lymphomap: Static author-reference feature selection using LymphoMapR 1.0, full author training gene pool and declared panel gene pool separately; no query expression. Native defaults: 50 per archetype, log2FC > 0.58, padj < 0.05, positive-z fractions > 0.5 in group and < 0.5 outside group.
provenance.caveat: Feature coverage is a design property; it does not establish assay detection, sample QC or classification accuracy.
